title: Create a Plugin for Nx
description: Create an Nx plugin under `tools/<group>/plugin`, wrapping `@nx/plugin:plugin` with the workspace naming, directory, and tag conventions (ADR 0009).

examples.description: Generates an Nx plugin project called `nx-plugin` at `tools/nx/plugin`.
Generates `release-plugin` at `tools/release/plugin` with npm-publish boilerplate and import path `@myorg/release-plugin`.

group.description: The `tools/<group>/plugin` folder segment, and the project-name prefix (`<group>-plugin`). Lowercase alphanumeric words joined by single hyphens.

name.description: Literal project-name override passed straight through to `@nx/plugin:plugin`. When given, it replaces the derived `<group>-plugin` name; the directory is still derived from `group`.

importPath.description: How the plugin will be published, like `@myorg/my-awesome-plugin`. Note this must be a valid NPM name.

linter.description: The tool to use for running lint checks.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner to use for unit tests. The workspace standardizes on Jest (ADR 0007).

tags.description: Additional freeform tags appended to the generated `scope:tools` / `type:plugin` tags, comma-separated.

compiler.description: The compiler used by the build and test targets.

e2eTestRunner.description: Test runner to use for end to end (E2E) tests.

e2eProjectDirectory.description: A directory where the plugin E2E project is placed.

publishable.description: Generates a boilerplate for publishing the plugin to npm.

useProjectJson.description: Use a `project.json` configuration file instead of inlining the Nx configuration in the `package.json` file.

enableTypedLinting.description: Whether to enable typed linting. For flat configs, this configures the recommended `parserOptions.projectService` and `tsconfigRootDir`. For legacy `.eslintrc` configs, this configures `parserOptions.project`. We do not enable this by default for lint performance reasons.

skipTsConfig.description: Do not update tsconfig.json for development experience.

skipLintChecks.description: Do not add eslint configuration for plugin json files.
